Finding submitted.

**Deviation — EXCLUSIVITY (Section 6.1)**

- **Issue:** Section 6.1 binds us, the Company, not to participate in any similar internet project for Deerskin Products (or substantially similar products) "during the term of this Agreement," while granting HDI the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" brand for a direct-to-consumer site.
- **Why it fails the fallback:** Section 4.1 makes the term evergreen (one year, auto-renewing on each anniversary), and exit requires 90 days' notice plus a Termination Payment under Section 4.2(a). So the restraint runs for the full open-ended term with no automatic performance-based release; the only performance exit is the narrow 70-day launch-failure right in Section 1.6.
- **Left intact:** Section 6.3 (two-year restraint on HDI) and Section 6.2 (closeout-site carve-out) benefit us and were not touched.
- **Redline (validated, fallback level):** exclusivity capped at the initial twelve months from the Effective Date, excluding renewal terms, plus automatic termination of our obligation, without payment or penalty, on HDI's failure to meet any service level, launch date or delivery date.
